pr.title: MCDC coverage: support nested decision coverage
pr.author: RenjiSann

analysis.originalLogic: In the initial MCDC implementation, `MCDCState` had one `decision_stack` and one `processing_decision`; `fetch_mcdc_condition_info` returned only `Option<ConditionInfo>`; `MCDCBranchSpan`/`MCDCDecisionSpan` carried `decision_depth: 0`; and LLVM allocated a single `mcdc.addr` conditional bitmap. `CondBitmapUpdate` and `TestVectorBitmapUpdate` therefore all targeted that single depth-0 bitmap, assuming one active decision context per function.
analysis.incorrectTransformation: The historical transformation fails to open a separate decision context when lowering a boolean expression nested inside an outer decision. Conditions from an inner if-expression such as `if b || c { true } else { false }` are handled in the enclosing decision at depth 0 and update the same temporary condition bitmap, instead of becoming their own MC/DC decision with its own condition stack, mappings, decision depth, and bitmap slot. The corrected transformation pushes an `MCDCDecisionCtx` while lowering the nested expression, records separate `MCDCDecision`/`MCDCBranch` mappings with the correct `decision_depth`, and indexes a vector of per-depth condition bitmaps.
analysis.inputDomain: Rust functions with boolean `if` conditions containing nested `if` expressions as operands, e.g. `if a && if b || c { true } else { false }`, including doubly nested decisions, a decision nested in the inner then-block, and a nested decision with only one condition. The comparison pair should keep the same bool parameters and control flow, changing only whether the inner expression is treated as a separate MCDC decision context/depth with separate bitmap handling or is merged into the enclosing depth-0 decision.
analysis.summary: MCDC coverage instrumentation must model nested boolean decisions with a stack of decision contexts and per-depth temporary condition bitmaps; the earlier single-context, single-bitmap lowering did not support if-expressions embedded inside an outer decision condition.
analysis.trigger: MCDC instrumentation is enabled while lowering a boolean decision whose operand contains an inner if-expression, such as `if a && if b || c { true } else { false }`, especially with multiple nesting levels or a nested decision inside the inner then-block.
preconditions: MCDC coverage is requested (`-Zcoverage-options=mcdc`) and LLVM 18 or later is used (`//@ min-llvm-version: 18`).
`BranchInfoBuilder`/`MCDCState` is active while THIR-to-MIR lowering processes the function's condition expressions.
A nested if-expression is lowered while the enclosing decision is still being processed, so a fresh decision context must be entered and later exited.
pitfalls: Do not attach every nested condition to the enclosing decision or leave all spans at depth 0; `decision_depth` must flow through `CoverageKind::CondBitmapUpdate`/`TestVectorBitmapUpdate`, `BcbMappingKind`, `MCDCBranchSpan`/`MCDCDecisionSpan`, and MIR pretty-printing.

Codegen needs a bitmap per depth, not one global bitmap: the patch allocates indices via `for i in 0..=max_decision_depth`, names them `mcdc.addr.{i}`, stores them in a `Vec`, and looks them up by `decision_depth`.
Push a fresh `MCDCDecisionCtx` around lowering the nested decision expression and pop it afterward; the stack starts with one default context and pop asserts it is not empty.

A nested decision with only one condition is intentionally left as branch coverage rather than MCDC; the test comment says this avoids wasting bitmap space because branch coverage is equivalent there.
Do not conflate decision depth with condition ID: tests show separate decision regions each reusing condition IDs 1 and 2.
`mcdc_max_decision_depth` should be computed from the final `MCDCDecision` mappings, with `unwrap_or(0)` for functions without decisions.
analysis.testStrategy: Use the added `tests/coverage/mcdc_nested_if.rs` style test compiled with `-Zcoverage-options=mcdc`, LLVM >=18, and `llvm-cov-flags: --show-mcdc`. Cover one-level nested (`nested_if_in_condition`), doubly nested (`doubly_nested_if_in_condition`), nested inside an inner then-block (`nested_in_then_block_in_condition`), and single-condition nested fallback (`nested_single_condition_decision`). Verify `.coverage` shows distinct MC/DC Decision Regions with the expected test vectors/pairs, and `.cov-map` shows separate `MCDCDecision` entries with distinct `bitmap_idx` and corresponding branch mappings; the single-condition nested case should retain a `Branch` mapping rather than an MCDC decision.
evidence: it does not currently support "nested" decisions, like the following example
Note that there is an if-expression (`if b || c ...`) embedded inside a boolean expression in the decision of an outer if-expression.
This PR proposes a workaround for this cases, by introducing a Decision context stack, and by handing several `temporary condition bitmaps` instead of just one.

When instrumenting boolean expressions, if the current node is a leaf condition (i.e. not a `||`/`&&` logical operator nor a `!` not operator), we insert a new decision context, such that if there are more boolean expressions inside the condition, they are handled as separate expressions.
On the codegen LLVM side, we allocate as many `temp_cond_bitmap`s as necessary to handle the maximum encountered decision depth.
